cases.name: etaf-bili-tests-popular-loads-rows-and-status
cases.purpose: Loading the popular feed replaces the rows with the parsed reply and reports the count on the status line.

cases.name: etaf-bili-tests-search-carries-keyword-and-replaces-rows
cases.purpose: Searching sends the keyword to the backend, shows the reply, and ignores blank input without sending a request.

cases.name: etaf-bili-tests-selection-moves-and-clamps
cases.purpose: Selection moves one row at a time and clamps at both ends of the list.

cases.name: etaf-bili-tests-play-selected-delivers-stream-source
cases.purpose: Playing the selected row resolves the stream source (URL plus CDN headers) and hands it to the caller.

cases.name: etaf-bili-tests-play-failure-only-changes-status
cases.purpose: A failed stream lookup reports on the status line and never calls the playback callback.

cases.name: etaf-bili-tests-wbi-query-signs-encode-uri-component
cases.purpose: WBI signing sorts keys, encodes like encodeURIComponent and appends the documented w_rid; missing keys signal an error.

cases.name: etaf-bili-tests-parse-videos-normalizes-rows
cases.purpose: Response parsing cleans search markup, converts string clocks to seconds and reads both the list and result array shapes.

cases.name: etaf-bili-gallery-tests-catalog-controls-and-scrolling
cases.purpose: Scroll continuously from the first to the last mounted card and back, then open and close details through catalog targets.

cases.name: etaf-bili-gallery-tests-search-editing-keeps-application-keys
cases.purpose: Type application shortcut characters in the inline search field and submit without triggering application commands.

cases.name: etaf-bili-gallery-tests-empty-error-and-stale-results
cases.purpose: Empty successful results clear the old library and stale searches cannot restore it.

cases.name: etaf-bili-gallery-tests-latest-play-request-wins
cases.purpose: Only the newest stream resolution reaches playback when replies arrive out of order.

cases.name: etaf-bili-gallery-tests-close-ignores-pending-response
cases.purpose: Closing a loading gallery prevents a late callback from resurrecting it.

cases.name: etaf-bili-gallery-tests-theme-preserves-frame-and-query
cases.purpose: Theme switching preserves the library and leaves frame decoration and the user theme unchanged.

cases.name: etaf-bili-gallery-tests-cover-cache-and-transfer-failure
cases.purpose: The public cover operation downloads through an offline curl fixture, reuses cached files and removes failed partial transfers.

cases.name: etaf-bili-tests-login-overlays-the-code-and-finishes-on-confirmation
cases.purpose: Signing in publishes the painted code in the session, closes the overlay once the phone confirms, and records the signed-in account without opening a second buffer.

cases.name: etaf-bili-tests-logout-calls-the-backend-after-confirmation
cases.purpose: Signing out asks for confirmation and only then asks the backend to clear the cookies.

cases.name: etaf-bili-tests-login-keeps-polling-until-the-phone-confirms
cases.purpose: A scanned code is polled again until the backend confirms it, so the panel closes.

cases.name: etaf-bili-tests-view-mounts-in-a-host-buffer
cases.purpose: A host mounts the View in its own buffer, the client's keys reach the adopted session, and mounting the same session again keeps the loaded library instead of fetching it again.

cases.name: etaf-bili-watch-tests-parse-target-bv-av-urls
cases.purpose: Target parsing recognizes BV IDs, av numbers, bilibili.com URLs with p/t parameters, and b23.tv short links while leaving plain search keywords untouched.

cases.name: etaf-bili-watch-tests-sqlite-store-progress-prefs-and-history
cases.purpose: SQLite store persists watch progress with start/end resume clamping, viewing preferences of all JSON types, and deduplicated capped search history.

cases.name: etaf-bili-watch-tests-subtitle-danmaku-and-timestamps
cases.purpose: Binary-search subtitle lookup, bounded danmaku windowing, and comment MM:SS/H:MM:SS timestamp extraction return exact matches.

cases.name: etaf-bili-watch-tests-cookie-jar-preserves-httponly-sessdata
cases.purpose: The bundled Node account backend parses #HttpOnly_ Netscape cookies, clears bilibili.com entries on logout, and atomically preserves other #HttpOnly_ cookies.

cases.name: etaf-bili-watch-tests-channels-filters-and-pagination
cases.purpose: Expanded channels (rcmd, partitioned ranking, sorted search, dynamic, toview, history, favorites, UP space) send expected parameters and pagination appends deduplicated items.

cases.name: etaf-bili-watch-tests-play-error-toast-preserves-gallery
cases.purpose: A failed single-video stream resolution shows a non-destructive Toast without wiping the mounted gallery cards.

cases.name: etaf-bili-watch-tests-watch-view-lifecycle-audio-only-and-org-link
cases.purpose: Watch View displays tabs, quality dialog, theater mode, Org timestamp copy, and audio-only background mode with a persistent gallery mini-player.

cases.name: etaf-bili-watch-tests-open-preserves-mode-line-and-reuses-buffer
cases.purpose: etaf-bili-open preserves the user's mode-line and reuses an existing live *Bili* session instead of restarting it.

cases.name: etaf-bili-watch-tests-unmount-resets-inflight-covers-for-remount
cases.purpose: Unmounting a kept-alive session while covers are in-flight resets transfer state so remounting downloads the covers cleanly.

cases.name: etaf-bili-watch-tests-danmaku-zero-jitter-and-audio-parity
cases.purpose: Watch View defaults to 100% unity volume with Hi-Res audio badge, keeps stage geometry invariant when toggling native danmaku, and persists sidebar danmaku settings.

cases.name: etaf-bili-watch-tests-hires-flac-audio-selection
cases.purpose: DASH stream selection prioritizes lossless Hi-Res FLAC audio over standard 192K AAC when available.

cases.name: etaf-bili-watch-tests-quality-dialog-keyboard-nav-and-alignment
cases.purpose: Quality picker and sidebar rows align labels flush without dot/arrow prefixes, and the quality dialog supports up/down arrow selection with RET activation.

cases.name: etaf-bili-watch-tests-fullscreen-modes-and-mode-line-restore
cases.purpose: Watch View exposes window and frame Pure Fullscreen sharing the aligned cinema deck, hides and restores mode-line cleanly, and exits fullscreen on Escape before leaving Watch.

cases.name: etaf-bili-watch-tests-cookie-jar-handles-crlf-windows-cookies
cases.purpose: Windows CRLF Netscape cookie jars strip CR cleanly in both the bundled Node account backend and curl CSRF POST operations.
